objective: Proof: from one knot, the cap of three knots per distinction and the cap of two knots per pair both stop at the 2 x 2 pattern; the fill bound 3K <= c n; the distance between matched starts cannot grow after the knots are erased.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): from one knot, a cap of three knots per distinction and a cap of two knots per pair each give the 2 x 2 pattern and then allow no move; under a degree cap c, at most (c n - 3n + 6)/6 three-knot steps from one knot; after erasure the total variation distance between two starts cannot increase under a states-only rule.
title: What the caps allow
